inherits.rule: V4 adds reader-experience gates; it does not retroactively change V3 historical verdicts.

V4-G1M.name: SCENE_ENTRY_MOTIVATION
V4-G1M.pass_condition: Every material entry/re-entry/role switch has a located causal trigger or an already-established continuing obligation.

V4-G5R.name: READER_PROPULSION_AND_REWARD
V4-G5R.pass_condition: Material spans create a changing reader question, expectation, pressure, reward or consequential choice; event progress alone is insufficient.

V4-G5S.name: SUSPENSE_HYPOTHESIS_ENGINE
V4-G5S.pass_condition: Carried mysteries support a working reader model, fair evidence, a remaining anomaly or competing model, a validation action/cost, and meaningful model update/payoff.

V4-G5E.name: EMOTIONAL_STAGING_AND_SCENE_VOLTAGE
V4-G5E.pass_condition: High-emotion scenes dramatize pressure, conflicting wants, subtext/behavior, consequential turns and aftershock rather than only reporting correct emotional facts.

V4-G6N.name: NATURAL_SPEECH_UNDER_PRESSURE
V4-G6N.pass_condition: High-information dialogue is packaged according to speaker urgency, relationship, listener knowledge and plausible omission/inference rather than reader-summary convenience.

V4-G7C.name: CLIMAX_ESCALATION_CURVE
V4-G7C.pass_condition: Major climaxes compress options, increase personal stakes, reactivate prior assets/relationships, force irreversible choice and leave proportionate payoff/aftershock.

V4-G9.name: FRESH_IMMERSION_READER
V4-G9.pass_condition: A fresh reader report locates actual stop/skim points, desire-to-continue drivers, active suspense hypotheses, emotionally stated-vs-experienced scenes and written-vs-spoken dialogue. No earlier gate may substitute for this evidence.
